title: Part 2 frames.json
description: Written by part2 frames next to the extracted images: one record per kept frame. frame and t_ms are the values later written into pose3d.json and tracks.json. t_ms counts from the first decoded frame; t0_pts_ms is that frame's own presentation time.

source.description: The video or directory the frames came from.

t0_pts_ms.description: Optional. The first decoded frame's presentation time in milliseconds, so a reader can rebase t_ms onto the file clock: file time = t_ms + t0_pts_ms.

file.description: Image file name inside the frames directory.
